title: About the Royal Society of Thailand

blocks.heading: About the Royal Society of Thailand
blocks.subtitle: The nation's central institution for language and culture
blocks.lead: A gathering of the nation's foremost scholars, dedicated to researching, developing, preserving, and disseminating knowledge for the benefit of Thai society and the public.

blocks.heading: From the Royal Society to the Office of the Royal Society
blocks.html: The evolution of a national academic institution, responsible for gathering, creating, and disseminating knowledge in language, science, and culture, so it can reach ever more of the public.
blocks.highlightText: Connecting knowledge from distinguished scholars to Thai society in practical, usable forms.

items.label: Origins
items.title: Rooted in the Work of the Royal Institute
items.body: The Royal Society traces its roots to the revival of the Royal Institute's work, with the aim of bringing together scholars to research and disseminate knowledge to the public.

items.label: Growth
items.title: Advancing Scholarship & the Thai Language
items.body: The organization's role has grown continuously — compiling dictionaries, coining terminology, producing encyclopedias, and setting standards for the Thai language.

items.label: Today
items.title: Connecting Knowledge to Society
items.body: The Office of the Royal Society supports the Society's mission through media, publications, databases, and academic services, so the public can access accurate knowledge.

blocks.heading: A Historical Timeline
blocks.lead: Key milestones reflecting the development of the Royal Society and its role in the nation's scholarship.

items.title: The “Royal Institute” Is Established
items.body: King Prajadhipok graciously ordered the establishment of the Royal Institute on 19 April 1926 (B.E. 2469).

blocks.heading: Roles & Key Mandates
blocks.lead: Creating knowledge, developing Thai-language standards, and providing academic services to the public — so that knowledge is accurate, trustworthy, and genuinely useful.

items.title: Research & Scholarship
items.body: Promoting research across disciplines to develop knowledge that benefits the country

items.title: Disseminate & Exchange Knowledge
items.body: Bringing academic work to the public through publications, digital media, databases, and academic activities

items.title: Develop & Preserve
items.body: Safeguarding academic, linguistic, artistic, and cultural heritage while keeping it contemporary

items.title: Academic Services
items.body: Providing reference information, terminology, standards, and guidance the public and agencies can put to practical use

blocks.heading: Organizational Structure
blocks.lead: The Royal Society's operations connect the Council of Fellows with the Office, driving academic work and public service in a coordinated way.
blocks.councilBody: Sets direction and academic policy, and approves regulations and key decisions relating to Fellows and the nation's scholarship.
blocks.officeBody: Provides academic and administrative support, publishes work, coordinates across bureaus, and delivers ongoing public services.
blocks.schoolsLead: The key mechanisms driving knowledge across different fields.
